aha: Two stone silos drain onto one shelf with three holes; each stone needs a hole or parking spot of its own: one left silo stone into each hole beside it, all right silo stones to the right, and the right silo's last stone must leave the diver on its right side.
deadlocks: Pushing both left-silo stones right: the second rolls over the filled hole and parks against the right silo, blocking it.
Pushing both left-silo stones left: the second rolls over the filled hole onto the gate.
Pushing a right-silo stone left: it rolls across the shelf onto the gate.
Delivering a pearl before the hole on its road is plugged.
